title: If the default changes while New Customer is open, the form keeps its term
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You and a second user, {User-B}, are both signed in with the "Admin" role, in two separate browsers.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-21 Second Admin.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • A name for the new customer, {Customer-A}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-21 Customer.
  • Starting screen: your browser shows the Customers page; {User-B}'s browser shows the Credit Terms page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Type {Customer-A} in Customer Name.
  3. In {User-B}'s browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 30" row.
  4. In {User-B}'s browser, click "Make Default for New Customers".
  5. In {User-B}'s browser, click "Make Default".
  6. In your browser, look at Credit Terms.
  7. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Customer" window opens.
  • Step 2: Credit Terms reads COD (Default).
  • Step 3: the menu opens.
  • Step 4: the confirmation opens.
  • Step 5: {User-B} sees "Net 30 is now the default".
  • Step 6: it still reads COD (the form keeps the term it showed).
  • Step 7: the customer is created on COD, the term the form showed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-E1: “If the default changes while New Customer is open, the form keeps the term already shown; the user's Save uses what the form shows.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
